title: vBacktoServerlist

body:
# vBacktoServerlist

[![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef01ad6b39a79dd292c4984e6b8a8c27b08d08c9.png)](https://discord.gg/5AWcWHBCPt)

# VBackToServerList

VBackToServerList is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that adds a clean **List** button directly to your pause menu.

With one click, you can jump straight back to the multiplayer server list without going through extra menus. The button position can be customized through **ModMenu**, giving you full control over where it appears on your screen.

## Features

- Adds a **List** button to the pause menu
- Instantly opens the multiplayer server list
- Button position is configurable through **ModMenu**
- Saves your selected position automatically
- Lightweight and client-side
